current_unit: Task 13: Address the Node 24 findings from Task 1 Step 4
notes: Task 12 (Node 24 in CI and an engines floor) completed cleanly this firing. Step 1: added `"engines": { "node": ">=24.0.0" }` to package.json. Step 2: both CI pins in .github/workflows/build-release.yml (macOS line 19, Windows line 96) changed from node-version: '20' to '24' -- grep confirmed exactly two matches, both '24'; git diff showed only these two intended hunks. Step 3 (verify on real Node 24) was the interesting part: this container's default node --version is v22.22.2, but investigation (not assumption) found nvm already installed at /opt/nvm -- ~/.bashrc sources it but that wasn't active in this tool's non-interactive shell, so `export NVM_DIR=/opt/nvm && source $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh` was enough to activate it. `nvm ls-remote --lts` reached nodejs.org fine through the proxy; `nvm install 24` downloaded and installed a genuine v24.21.0 (checksum verified) with no workarounds needed. Ran the real verification on that Node 24 (after `npm run install:companion`, the same pre-existing companion-module gap Task 11 hit): npx vitest run -> 86/86 files, 1253/1253 tests, exact match to docs/plans/electron32-test-baseline.txt; npx tsc --noEmit clean. No Node-24-sensitive failures found, so the dispatch's documented fallback (verify on Node 22 and note the gap) was not needed -- got genuine positive Node-24 signal instead. Step 4: committed package.json + .github/workflows/build-release.yml as c0ff3e0 with the full verification story in the commit body. Left a note in JOURNAL.md for future firings in this same container: sourcing /opt/nvm/nvm.sh and `nvm use 24` gets real Node 24 with no tarball-fetching or package-manager workaround needed. No native-binding/code-signing/notarization work in Task 12 itself (that's Task 14), so no pause-before-native-work consideration applied here. free_reset_available untouched at true -- ordinary clean unit completion, nothing time-sensitive. Task 13 is likely a no-op per the plan text ("If Task 1 found nothing, mark this task skipped") -- next firing should check docs/plans/electron-44-breaking-changes.md's Node section first.
